mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.cover AS item_cover, e.points_cost, e.status, e.address, e.exchange_time, u.username, u.nickname FROM portal_shop_exchange e LEFT JOIN portal_shop_item i ON e.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN portal_user u ON e.user_id = u.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} order by e.exchange_time desc
